name: Ultra
summary: Ultra is an abstract arcade shooter, a modern homage to Atari's Tempest. The player pilots a craft around the outer rim of a 3D web, shooting flippers, tankers and spikers as they climb towards them, armed with a plasma side arm and an Ion Splitter that clears the screen. Fifty arenas are set to a reactive light show and a customisable music track list, with the visuals responding to the beat of the music.
